description: Establish the green baseline AND re-integrate the human-governance core (from superseded PR #24 / origin/feat/admin-governance-layer) onto current main. The governance modules were designed on a branch that is now 21 commits behind main and no longer merges cleanly; the modules themselves (directory.py, govern.py, the keys/identity additions, their unit tests) are self-contained and port verbatim, while the api.py enforcement cut (moving assert_owner out of _principal into a per-route _authorize so /admin/* can use the RBAC matrix) must be RE-APPLIED against main's current api.py rather than merged. This feature delivers the backend governance engine + its wiring point, green, WITHOUT yet adding admin action routes (those are FEAT-003). This is a re-integration, not a rebuild: do not redesign directory.py/govern.py.
steps: Confirm the toolchain: .venv/bin/python --version prints 3.11.15. Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and confirm the baseline is EXACTLY 992 passed / 3 failed, where the 3 failures are tests/test_gaps_api.py::{test_activity_after_the_marker_makes_it_unread_again, test_only_actual_files_are_listed_not_sealed_runs, test_files_are_newest_first}. If the venv is missing, build it with /root/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python3.11 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt. Also confirm `cd infra && npm install && npx cdk synth` exits 0 and `cd web && npm install && npm run build` produces web/dist/index.html.

Port services/amazai/directory.py VERBATIM from the branch: `git show origin/feat/admin-governance-layer:services/amazai/directory.py`. It imports `from amazai.agents import Escalation, ValidationError`, `from amazai import keys as K`, `from amazai.store import now_iso` -- confirm those symbols still exist on current main (they do). Do not alter the CAPABILITIES matrix.

Port services/amazai/govern.py VERBATIM from the branch: `git show origin/feat/admin-governance-layer:services/amazai/govern.py`. It imports `from amazai.agents import Actor`, `from amazai.directory import Membership`, `from amazai.store import new_id, now_iso, ordered_suffix`, `from amazai import keys as K`. Confirm those exist on main.

Add the three key builders to services/amazai/keys.py from the branch diff (`git diff main origin/feat/admin-governance-layer -- services/amazai/keys.py`): org_pk(org_id)->'ORG#<org_id>', member_sk(subject)->'MEMBER#<subject>', admin_audit_sk(iso, suffix)->'ADMINAUDIT#<iso>#<suffix>'. Place them alongside the existing builders, keep the WHY comments.

Add identity.load_membership(store, principal) to services/amazai/identity.py from the branch diff (`git diff main origin/feat/admin-governance-layer -- services/amazai/identity.py`): reads the MEMBER# row under the caller's org partition (K.org_pk(principal.org_id), K.member_sk(principal.user_id)); when none exists, returns an implicit ACTIVE OWNER Membership of that org (the honest single-tenant seam). Import directory lazily inside the function (as the branch does) to avoid an import cycle. Keep the HONEST LIMITATION docstring/comment.

Re-apply the api.py enforcement cut against current main's services/handlers/api.py: (a) add `directory as D, govern` to the `from amazai import (...)` block; (b) REMOVE the inline `identity.assert_owner(principal)` from `_principal()` so _principal only verifies+caches the token; (c) add `_RBAC_ROUTE_PREFIX = '/admin/'` and a new `_authorize(event, path)` helper (port its docstring from `git show origin/feat/admin-governance-layer:services/handlers/api.py`) that calls _principal then runs identity.assert_owner ONLY when the path is not '/admin' and does not start with _RBAC_ROUTE_PREFIX; (d) in handler(), replace the `principal = _principal(event)` line (currently ~line 173, before building the Store) with `principal = _authorize(event, path)` so the owner allowlist still gates every non-admin route exactly as before. Do NOT change the Store/ensure_user/_route call that follows. Keep main's imports of org, provisioning, dispatch, cost, continuation, stream intact -- the branch had removed some of these only because it predated them.

Add govern.Frozen and govern.PrincipalNotActive to the handler() exception mapping in api.py: both subclass PermissionError, so main's existing `except PermissionError -> 403` already covers them; confirm this and add an explicit comment noting the kill-switch/offboarding paths map to 403 (no code change needed if PermissionError already maps).

Port the governance unit tests VERBATIM from the branch: tests/test_directory.py and tests/test_govern.py (`git show origin/feat/admin-governance-layer:tests/test_directory.py` etc). Port the load_membership boundary test from tests/test_identity.py -- inspect `git show origin/feat/admin-governance-layer:tests/test_identity.py` and add ONLY the new TestMembershipSeam block (do not clobber main's existing identity tests; append the new class).

Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` and confirm 992 + (new directory/govern/identity tests) all pass and the 3 test_gaps_api.py failures are unchanged. Confirm no NEW failures. Confirm the existing owner-allowlist tests still pass (the assert_owner move must not weaken them -- non-admin routes still enforce it).
Ensure no __pycache__/*.pyc changes are staged. Leave the working tree clean apart from the new/edited source files.
acceptance_criteria: services/amazai/directory.py and services/amazai/govern.py exist on the working tree and are byte-for-byte the branch versions (allowing only import-path fixes if a symbol genuinely moved on main).
keys.py exposes org_pk, member_sk, admin_audit_sk; identity.py exposes load_membership.
api.py::_principal no longer calls assert_owner; api.py::_authorize applies assert_owner to every non-/admin route; handler() calls _authorize(event, path).
`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` shows the ported test_directory.py/test_govern.py plus the new TestMembershipSeam passing, with the ONLY failures being the 3 pre-existing test_gaps_api.py ones.
`cd infra && npx cdk synth` exits 0 and `cd web && npm run build` produces web/dist/index.html.
No admin ACTION routes yet (invite/suspend/reset/archive) -- those are FEAT-002/003; this feature only lands the engine + wiring seam.
verification: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q  (expect only the 3 known test_gaps_api.py failures; all governance tests green)
cd web && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html
findings: COMPLETED. Re-integrated the governance core onto current main (not a merge). Steps done: (1) Baseline confirmed EXACTLY 992 passed / 3 failed (the known tests/test_gaps_api.py trio, moto/boto3 drift, left untouched). (2) Ported services/amazai/directory.py VERBATIM (md5 matches branch). (3) Ported services/amazai/govern.py VERBATIM (md5 matches branch). (4) Added org_pk/member_sk/admin_audit_sk to keys.py after agent_pk, with the branch WHY comments. (5) Added identity.load_membership between ensure_user and the owner allowlist, with lazy `from amazai import directory as D` and the full HONEST LIMITATION comment; K and Store were already imported. (6) Re-applied the api.py enforcement cut against main: added `directory as D, govern` to the `from amazai import dispatch, ...` line (kept ALL of main's imports incl. org/provisioning/dispatch); removed the inline `identity.assert_owner(principal)` from _principal (kept only verify+cache) and appended the branch's WHO-not-whether docstring; added `_RBAC_ROUTE_PREFIX = '/admin/'` and `_authorize(event, path)` (assert_owner unless path == '/admin' or startswith the prefix); changed handler() from `principal = _principal(event)` to `principal = _authorize(event, path)`. (7) Confirmed govern.Frozen/PrincipalNotActive subclass PermissionError which handler() already maps to 403; added a WHY comment there (no new except). (8) Ported tests/test_directory.py and tests/test_govern.py VERBATIM (md5 match); appended ONLY the TestMembershipSeam class into tests/test_identity.py between TestUserRecord and TestOwnerAllowlist (existing identity tests untouched). VERIFICATION: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` = 1218 passed / 3 failed (only the pre-existing test_gaps_api.py trio; +226 governance tests all green; owner-allowlist tests still pass). Targeted run of test_directory.py/test_govern.py/test_identity.py all green. `cd infra && npx cdk synth` exit 0. `cd web && npm run build` produces web/dist/index.html with `grep -c demoApi` == 0. NOTE for later features: node/npm are not on the default PATH; prepend /root/.nvm/versions/node/v18.20.8/bin. Committed source-only (8 files, no __pycache__/*.pyc) as 7fc979f; NOT pushed (orchestrator handles that). No admin ACTION routes added (those are FEAT-002/003).
